kpsae01.title: Saturn Puts Aries on a Slow Clock
kpsae01.caption:
Asking "are we exclusive?" before the appetisers are even cold. Saturn had to slam a ring down like a hurdle.
Aries, how long did you last before asking?

kpsae02.title: Saturn Gets Taurus Off the Couch
kpsae02.caption: Fifty-two cosy movie nights and nobody has said what this is. Comfy is lovely, but clear is kinder: say what you want, simply. Wanting to know isn't too much.

kpsae03.title: Saturn vs Gemini's Four Maybes
kpsae03.caption:
Four chats, four "maybe!"s, one Saturday. Saturn brought a form with one box and Gemini still drew a second one.
Tag the friend who answers every plan with "maybe!"

kpsae04.title: Saturn Teaches Cancer a Soft No
kpsae04.caption: Being the friend everyone leans on is beautiful, and it's tiring. A kind "not tonight, but I love you" keeps your yes real. Boundaries are doors, not walls.

kpsae05.title: Saturn Explains Reliable to Leo
kpsae05.caption:
On time, remembered the coffee order, texted "home safe". Leo asked where the banner was.
Saturn says steady is a love language. Agree?

kpsae06.title: Standards or a Wall, Virgo?
kpsae06.caption: A lovely date, cancelled by rule 37 of forty. Standards protect you, but a list that long keeps everyone out. Keep the few that matter (kind, honest, shows up) and let the rest be curiosity.

kpsae07.title: Saturn Books Libra's "Sometime"
kpsae07.caption:
Six months of "we should hang out sometime!" and still not one date in the calendar. Saturn brought a calendar and a giant hourglass.
What's your longest-running "sometime"?

kpsae08.title: Saturn and Scorpio's Spare Key
kpsae08.caption: Liking someone and keeping them at arm's length, just in case. Trust isn't one big leap. It's small promises, kept, and you get to let people in one ring at a time.

kpsae09.title: Saturn Unpacks Sagittarius
kpsae09.caption:
2 a.m., packing for a "totally random" trip the night before the what-are-we talk. Saturn zipped the suitcase shut with its own ring.
Sag, be honest: have you ever done this?

kpsae10.title: Saturn's Talk With Capricorn
kpsae10.caption: Four plans cancelled this week, all because work ran late. Saturn didn't come to check your productivity. Love isn't a promotion you earn: you already qualify. Save this for the next late night at the desk.

kpsae11.title: Saturn Labels Aquarius
kpsae11.caption:
"We're just two free agents," said after ninety days of good-morning texts, with their toothbrush in the cup.
Aquarius, what would you call it?

kpsae12.title: Saturn Slows Pisces Down, Gently
kpsae12.caption: Date two, and the wedding speech is already on draft four. Falling fast is a gift. Get to know who they are over time, not who you hope they'll be, and let them earn the speech.
